questions.question: How does ReviewLab test AI tools?
questions.answer: ReviewLab evaluates AI software using a structured methodology covering setup, usability, performance, output quality, pricing, support, updates and competitive positioning.

questions.question: Are ReviewLab rankings sponsored?
questions.answer: ReviewLab rankings are intended to be based on the site's review methodology rather than paid placement.

questions.question: How often are reviews updated?
questions.answer: Reviews can be updated when pricing, features, product versions or testing results materially change.
